title: Madurantakam by-election: Will the AIADMK ‘bastion’ fall to TVK’s growing popularity?
description: Maragatham Kumaravel, a former AIADMK leader, now seeks re-election as the TVK’s candidate after resigning as AIADMK MLA barely three weeks after the 2026 result; while some voters are undecided, some say they may not vote for the TVK despite the CM’s popularity
